title: White Bread
directions: Prepare 1 pkg. of yeast as directed.
Add yeast to rest of ingred., adding flour & beat until smooth.
Knead enough flour into mixture to make a stiff smooth dough.
Place in greased bowl. Cover, let rise until double.
Punch down & let rise again, until double.
Form into loaves & set into a warm place to rise.
Bake @ 375° for 1 hour.
notes: over — Brown bread (Brown Bread recipe is on the back, photo 161)

title: Brown Bread
directions: Mix in usual method & let rise 3/4 hr.
Knead down & let rise 30 min.
Put on pans to rise for 1 hour.
Bake @ 375° for 1 hour.
notes: Written on the back of the White Bread card (photo 160), which says 'over — Brown bread'; attribution inferred from front of card

title: Foundation Sweet Dough
ingredients: 1/2 tsp nutmeg or 1/2 lemon, rind & juice may be added
directions: Scald milk, pour over sugar, salt & shortening.
Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water.
Add beaten eggs.
Add yeast & beaten eggs to lukewarm milk. Beat well.
Add flour grad. Knead lightly. Let rise till double in bulk.
Make into cinnamon or butterscotch rolls or buns.

title: Irish Soda Bread
directions: Preheat oven to 350° F (180° C).
In a bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking soda, baking powder and salt.
Cut in butter until mixture resembles fine crumbs.
Stir in currants and buttermilk to make a soft dough.
Turn onto a lightly floured surface and knead for 1 minute.
Shape into a round loaf, about 7" (18 cm) in diameter. Place on a greased baking sheet.
Cut an "x" in the centre of the loaf.
Bake for 45 minutes until golden brown.
notes: Printed clipping; title 'IRISH SODA BREAD' also handwritten in blue ink on the clipping
Intro: In the old days, this Irish favourite was baked in an iron pot over a fire. This hearty bread is marked with an 'X' so it breaks easily into four farls (old Irish word for 'quarter').
raw_text:
IRISH SODA BREAD
In the old days, this Irish favourite was baked in an iron pot over a fire.
This hearty bread is marked with an "X" so it breaks easily into four
farls (old Irish word for "quarter").          IRISH SODA BREAD [handwritten]
2 1/2 cups   flour                     625 mL
2 Tbsp.      sugar                      25 mL
1 tsp.       baking soda                 5 mL
2 tsp.       baking powder              10 mL
1/2 tsp.     salt                        2 mL
1/4 cup      butter or margarine        50 mL
1/4 cup      currants                   50 mL
1 cup        buttermilk                250 mL
Preheat oven to 350° F (180° C).
In a bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking soda, baking powder and salt.
Cut in butter until mixture resembles fine crumbs. Stir in currants and
buttermilk to make a soft dough. Turn onto a lightly floured surface
and knead for 1 minute. Shape into a round loaf, about 7" (18 cm) in
diameter. Place on a greased baking sheet. Cut an "x" in the centre of
the loaf. Bake for 45 minutes until golden brown.

title: Blueberry Pumpkin Muffins — Homemade with Love
ingredients: 1 cup firmly packed light brown sugar
directions: Combine first six ingredients. Combine pumpkin and evaporated milk until blended.
Cream shortening and sugar in large mixer bowl. Add egg; beat until mixture is fluffy.
Add flour mixture alternately with pumpkin mixture, beating well after each addition.
Combine blueberries and flour. Gently stir into batter.
Fill 18 paper-lined muffin tins 3/4 full. Sprinkle Streusel over top of muffins.
Bake in moderate oven (350° F.) 40 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.
Streusel: Combine 2 tablespoons flour, 2 tablespoons sugar, and 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon. Cut in 1 tablespoon butter until mixture is crumbly.
notes: Note: For larger muffins, use 12 paper-lined muffin tins.
Package clipping with Libby's Solid Pack Pumpkin can pictured; the word 'Blueberry' at top is partly cut off

For thinner pancakes add 1/4 c extra milk.

Banana: add 1 med. banana cut into 1/4" pieces & sprinkle of ground nutmeg.

title: Banana Bread (Best — bridge)
directions: With electric beater cream butter & sugar until light & fluffy.
Add bananas & eggs & beat until well mixed.
Sift dry ingredients 3 times — blend with banana mixture — do not overmix.
Pour into 2 greased loaf pans.
Bake @ 350° for 45 min – 1 hour. Cool 10 min before removing from pan.

title: Potato Pancakes
directions: 1. In a food processor, dice or shred potatoes & onion briefly until med. fine. Add eggs & process a bit more, then add flour, bk. pwd, seasonings & process to make a batter.
2. Heat oil in lg fry pan. (sm. ones are crispier) Brown on each side, turning once — drain on paper towel.
3. Serve with sour cream & applesauce on side.
notes: recommend red-skin potatoes or Potomac or Yukon Gold.

title: The Best Blueberry Muffins
directions: Beat marg. till creamy. Add sugar & beat. Add eggs 1 at a time.
Beat in vanilla, bkg. pwd. & salt.
With a spatula fold in 1/2 flour, then 1/2 the milk. Repeat — fold in blueberries.
Bake @ 375° for 25-30 min.
Makes 18 reg. size.
notes: Printed card: 'Recipe: ... from the kitchen of: Jennifer P.  Yield:' with sunflower border
Last steps written sideways up the right margin: 'Repeat — fold in blueberries. Bake @ 375° for 25-30 min. Makes 18 reg. size.'
raw_text:
Recipe: The Best Blueberry Muffins.        Yield:
from the kitchen of: Jennifer P.
1/2 c margarine            1/4 tsp. salt
1 c sugar or less          2 1/2 c blueberries
2 lg. eggs                 2 c flour
1 tsp. vanilla             1/2 c milk
2 " bk. pwd.
Beat marg. till creamy. Add sugar & beat. Add eggs 1 at a time.
Beat in vanilla, bkg. pwd. & salt. c̄ a spatula fold in 1/2 flour, then 1/2 the milk.
[sideways, right margin:] Repeat — fold in blueberries.
Bake @ 375° for 25-30 min.
Makes 18 reg. size.
